description: Implement, verify, push, open a pull request, fix red CI.

nodes.name: implement
nodes.prompt: Implement the claimed issue in this worktree and commit the change. If a failing step's output is attached, fix what it reports first. File a ready report when the work is committed, or a blocked report naming what stops you.

nodes.name: fix-ci
nodes.prompt: Required checks failed on the pull request; the failed step logs are attached. Fix the cause in this worktree and commit, then file a ready report, or a blocked report naming what stops you.

nodes.name: done
nodes.message: Verified, pushed, and the pull request checks are green.
